errors.policy: accepted outputs, intervals, distances and metrics are finite; overflow and invalid values fail closed with a typed error

normalization.inputs: per-dimension training minimum/span; unrepresentable finite spans are rejected
normalization.constant_dimensions: unit span preserves query drift detection
normalization.outputs: stable population mean and standard deviation
normalization.signed_zero: both signs canonicalize to +0.0 before identity or grouping

exact_gp.observation_noise: optional per-row physical variance, normalized by output scale squared

prediction.mean: posterior latent mean in physical units
prediction.variance: calibrated posterior latent variance in squared physical units
prediction.extreme_extrapolation: stable zero covariance limit or typed rejection

model_hash_covers: ARD/isotropic mode and fitted length-scale vector
complete jitter policy and selected jitter
calibration scale, nominal probability and source
OOD metric, quantile, multiplier and exact-coordinate tolerance
identity.load: reject unknown keys, verify canonical model hash, reject unsupported policy constants, refit and require exact deterministic artifact reconstruction

calibration_and_assessment.nominal_probability: carried through predictions, calibrator and reports
calibration_and_assessment.rmse_acceptance: RMSE / declared positive output scale <= one predeclared output-independent threshold
calibration_and_assessment.software_reproducibility: exact expected dataset, split, configuration and benchmark hashes only
calibration_and_assessment.model_quality: all per-output RMSE and coverage gates; never implied by reproducibility

spatial_split.leakage_prevention: transitive closure over caller group IDs and exact canonical coordinates
spatial_split.near_coordinate_policy: nonzero tolerance rejected; callers must supply unit-aware canonical groups
